title: 卢锡安·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深肤面容配修整利落的胡须，深色长外套带白金哨兵饰边。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Lucian is a dark-skinned adult man with short textured hair, a neatly shaped beard, focused eyes, and a long dark coat bearing white and gold Sentinel accents. Preserve his strong natural adult proportions with a fully covering high-collared shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His paired relic pistols remain secured in closed side holsters, never drawn, aimed, or glowing.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lilac pencil shadow, warm brown, ivory gold, cool slate; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
